name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote – 72
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 1b. The Commission shall monitor the organisational adequacy of the competent authorities of Member States and shall publish every five years a report on the state of implementation of this Article, accompanied by specific recommendations for Member States presenting structural deficiencies in the staffing or resources of their competent authorities.
